marta.g: Hi — running into a pretty weird failure when calling the file_tool via the API. If the tool args contain percent signs (eg. %USER% or %s) the request ends up failing schema validation with a truncated JSON body. Repro steps below.

marta.g: Repro (minimal):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/call -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"tool":"file_tool","args":"{\"path\":\"/mnt/data/%USER%/notes.txt\",\"note\":\"contains % and %s tokens\"}"}'
```
Response: 400 {"error":"invalid_tool_args", "message":"unexpected end of JSON input"}

marta.g: The client (internal CLI) is Node v16 + our wrapper. Works fine if I replace `%` with `%%` or remove the `%s` bit.

alex_support: Thanks, Marta. Can you paste the raw request body we receive (from the gateway) and the client lib version? Also which SDK/wrapper are you using?

marta.g: SDK: internal-cli v2.3.1. Attached gateway log snippet (I copied the request body we logged at the edge):
```
received_body: {"tool":"file_tool","args":"{\"path\":\"/mnt/data/\"}"
```
Notice the args string got cut right before the `%USER%` chunk.

samir_eng: This looks like a format-string expansion somewhere — eg. a vsprintf/sprintf call eating % sequences when building the log/template before forwarding. Do you have any logging that calls util.format or similar on user-provided payloads?

marta.g: We do call logger.info('calling tool with %s', args) in one place, but that should pass args as a value, not format the args string itself. However our wrapper does a small shim that constructs a payload template before sending and I see a legacy sprintf usage in native addon (C++) used by one team.

alex_support: Two quick asks: 1) Can you try escaping percent signs as `%%` in your payload as a temporary workaround? 2) Please capture the raw tcp request to the gateway (or use `--trace-ascii` in curl) so we can confirm if truncation occurs client-side or at the edge.

marta.g: Workaround verified: doubling `%` works. I ran `-d '{"tool":"file_tool","args":"{\"path\":\"/mnt/data/%%USER%%/notes.txt\"}"}'` and the request goes through. I'll capture a tcpdump and paste it here.

samir_eng: If doubling `%` fixes it, answer is likely client-side formatting. Escalating to eng-runtime for a patch and will add guardrails in the gateway to not perform any printf-style formatting on payloads. Filing ticket INF-4921, tagging @eng-runtime.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled for eng-runtime patch: canary 03:00 UTC tomorrow.

alex_support: Next steps for you, Marta: 1) keep using `%%` as stopgap; 2) if you can, update to the patched internal-cli once INF-4921 is released; 3) share the tcpdump output if you captured it so we can close the loop (client vs edge). Thanks! :thumbsup:

marta.g: Will do — thanks for the quick triage. :eyes:
